topic: Mathar's three-term recurrence, its rational square-root quotient extension, and Barker's Hankel generating functions
title: Explicit proofs of Mathar's recurrence and Barker's Hankel formulas from Mathar's and Cigler's theorems

creators.name: Wenlin Zhang
creators.affiliation: National University of Singapore; ChronoAI Pte Ltd, Singapore

abstract: Using Mathar's inverse-root theorem (2021, Theorem 2 and Example 4) and Cigler's determinant theorem (2002 volume, Theorem 2), we give explicit proofs of Mathar's three-term conjecture in OEIS A128057, revision 11, FORMULA (2 December 2014), by coefficient pairing, and Barker's empirical Hankel generating function in OEIS A128056, revision 5, FORMULA (27 June 2013), by a block determinant, respectively. The A128057 recurrence holds for every n >= 2. A polynomial identity gives the corresponding three-term recurrence for (u+v*x)/sqrt(1+c*x^2) with arbitrary rational parameters. The same determinant argument proves Barker's quotient generating function, gives the unsigned and shifted Hankel transforms, and corrects related sign, parity and indexing statements.
summary: Complete written proofs spell out consequences of Mathar's and Cigler's earlier theorems, a uniform rational-parameter short recurrence, transform corollaries and explicit corrections. Exact finite checks include 150 direct Hankel determinants. The pinned Lean declaration covers the normalized root, inverse and original A128057 recurrence; the parameterized theorem and Hankel consequences have written proofs and separate exact finite checks.
